tasks.label: Release: build iOS IPA
tasks.command: flutter build ipa --release --dart-define-from-file=release.json --export-options-plist=ios/ExportOptions.plist && python3 tool/check_release.py --strict --config release.json --bundle build/ios/archive/Runner.xcarchive/Products/Applications/Runner.app

tasks.label: Release: build macOS package
tasks.command: flutter build macos --release --config-only --dart-define-from-file=release.json && xcodebuild -workspace macos/Runner.xcworkspace -scheme Runner -configuration Release -archivePath "build/macos/archive/Keygen Client.xcarchive" CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO archive && python3 tool/check_release.py --strict --config release.json --bundle "build/macos/archive/Keygen Client.xcarchive/Products/Applications/Keygen Client.app" && python3 tool/prepare_macos_archive.py "build/macos/archive/Keygen Client.xcarchive" && xcodebuild -exportArchive -archivePath "build/macos/archive/Keygen Client.xcarchive" -exportPath build/macos/store -exportOptionsPlist macos/ExportOptions.plist -allowProvisioningUpdates
